name: Competition Daily Log
description: Generates a daily work summary for AWS AIdeas Challenge compliance

then.prompt:
Generate a daily progress summary for the AWS AIdeas Challenge. Review recent git commits and create an entry with the following format:

## [Date] Daily Progress
### Implemented Features
- (Summarize git diffs and what was built)
### Architecture Decisions
- (Explain why specific AWS services were used)
### AI Agent Interaction
- (Note: Generated via Kiro Agent)

Append this summary to docs/kiro-logs/work-log.md. If the file doesn't exist, create it with a header '# EcoBid Development Log - AWS AIdeas Challenge'.
